text:
Come, Holy Spirit, enlighten my mind,
that I may clearly know my sins.
Move my heart to true sorrow for having offended You,
Who are all good and deserving of all my love.
Grant me the grace to make a sincere confession,
to confess my sins with humility and honesty,
and to resolve firmly to amend my life.
Help me to perform the penance given me
with a spirit of love and gratitude.
Amen.
